criteria.text: The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of NSCLC with locally advanced, unresectable Stage IIIB or IIIC not eligible for definitive chemoradiotherapy or metastatic (Stage IV: M1a, M1b, or M1c) disease per the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) Staging Manual, Version 8.0, and the Union for International Cancer Control (UICC) Staging System.

source.text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of NSCLC with locally advanced, unresectable Stage IIIB or IIIC not eligible for definitive chemoradiotherapy or metastatic (Stage IV: M1a, M1b, or M1c) disease per the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) Staging Manual, Version 8.0, and the Union for International Cancer Control (UICC) Staging System.

criteria.text: The participant has a neuroendocrine component or histology.

source.text: Note: Participants with a neuroendocrine component or histology are not eligible.

criteria.text: PD-L1 expression is on ≥1% of tumor cells based on local immunohistochemistry (IHC) testing with an assay utilizing the anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody clones 22C3 or SP263.

source.text: PD-L1 expression on ≥1% of tumor cells based on local immunohistochemistry (IHC) testing with an assay utilizing the anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody clones 22C3 or SP263.

criteria.text: The participant has NSCLC with known AGAs.

source.text: Participants who have NSCLC with known AGAs are permitted.

criteria.text: The participant is able to provide tumor tissues for biomarker analysis.

source.text: Able to provide any of the following tumor tissues for biomarker analysis:

criteria.text: The participant has an archival specimen (preferably collected within 12 months after the last anticancer therapy).

source.text: Archival specimen (preferably collected within 12 months after the last anticancer therapy) (see laboratory manual for details); or

criteria.text: The participant has a de novo biopsy from a tumor lesion, if medically feasible.

source.text: De novo biopsy from a tumor lesion, if medically feasible.

criteria.text: The participant has received therapies and progressed during or relapsed after receiving their most recent prior therapy, or has been intolerant to their most recent therapy.

source.text: Participants must have received the following therapies and progressed during or relapsed after receiving their most recent prior therapy, or have been intolerant to their most recent therapy:

criteria.text: The participant has no known AGAs and fulfills 1 of the following conditions.

source.text: Participants with no known AGAs must fulfill 1 of the following conditions:

criteria.text: The participant received a platinum-based combination therapy for the treatment of metastatic or recurrent disease, and unless contraindicated, a PD-(L)1 monoclonal antibody (concurrently or sequentially with platinum-based chemotherapy).

source.text: Received a platinum-based combination therapy for the treatment of metastatic or recurrent disease, and unless contraindicated, a PD-(L)1 monoclonal antibody (concurrently or sequentially with platinum-based chemotherapy).

criteria.text: The participant experienced disease progression within 6 months of the last dose of platinum-based chemotherapy in the adjuvant, neoadjuvant, or chemoradiotherapy setting and received a PD-(L)1 monoclonal antibody at any time during the course of treatment.

source.text: Experienced disease progression within 6 months of the last dose of platinum-based chemotherapy in the adjuvant, neoadjuvant, or chemoradiotherapy setting and received a PD-(L)1 monoclonal antibody at any time during the course of treatment.

criteria.text: The participant has known AGAs (eg, EGFR mutations, ALK translocations, or other relevant actionable mutations) and fulfills the following conditions.

source.text: Participants with known AGAs (eg, EGFR mutations, ALK translocations, or other relevant actionable mutations) must fulfill the following conditions:

criteria.text: The participant has received at least 1 relevant AGA-targeted therapy if locally available and, in the opinion of the investigator, additional AGA-targeted therapy is not in the best interest of the participant.

source.text: Must have received at least 1 relevant AGA-targeted therapy if locally available and, in the opinion of the investigator, additional AGA-targeted therapy is not in the best interest of the participant

criteria.text: The participant received a platinum-based combination therapy for the treatment of metastatic or recurrent disease, or experienced disease progression within 6 months of the last dose of platinum-based chemotherapy in the adjuvant, neoadjuvant, or chemoradiotherapy setting.

source.text: Received a platinum-based combination therapy for the treatment of metastatic or recurrent disease, or experienced disease progression within 6 months of the last dose of platinum-based chemotherapy in the adjuvant, neoadjuvant, or chemoradiotherapy setting.

criteria.text: The participant may have received PD-(L)1 monoclonal antibody (concurrently or sequentially with platinum-based chemotherapy).

source.text: May have received PD-(L)1 monoclonal antibody (concurrently or sequentially with platinum-based chemotherapy).

criteria.text: The participant has a history of another malignancy within 3 years before the first dose of PF-08046054, or any evidence of residual disease from a previously diagnosed malignancy.

source.text: History of another malignancy within 3 years before the first dose of PF-08046054, or any evidence of residual disease from a previously diagnosed malignancy.

criteria.text: The participant does not have a malignancy with a negligible risk of metastasis or death (eg, 5-year overall survival [OS] ≥90%), such as adequately treated carcinoma in situ of the cervix, non-melanoma skin carcinoma, localized prostate cancer, ductal carcinoma in situ, or Stage I uterine cancer.

source.text: Exceptions are malignancies with a negligible risk of metastasis or death (eg, 5-year overall survival \[OS\] ≥90%), such as adequately treated carcinoma in situ of the cervix, non-melanoma skin carcinoma, localized prostate cancer, ductal carcinoma in situ, or Stage I uterine cancer.

criteria.text: The participant has any central nervous system (CNS) lesions, unless definitively treated with CNS-directed local therapy (surgery and/or radiotherapy).

source.text: Any central nervous system (CNS) lesions, unless definitively treated with CNS-directed local therapy (surgery and/or radiotherapy).

criteria.text: The participant has definitively treated brain metastases and meets the following criteria.

source.text: Participants with definitively treated brain metastases are eligible if they meet the following criteria:

criteria.text: The participant is on a stable dose of ≤10 mg/day of prednisone or equivalent for at least >14 days prior to randomization (if requiring steroid treatment).

source.text: The participant is on a stable dose of ≤10 mg/day of prednisone or equivalent for at least \>14 days prior to randomization (if requiring steroid treatment).

criteria.text: There is no clinical or radiographic progression in the CNS following CNS-directed definitive radiotherapy and/or surgery.

source.text: No clinical or radiographic progression in the CNS following CNS-directed definitive radiotherapy and/or surgery.

criteria.text: The time since CNS-directed treatment is ≥28 days prior to randomization.

source.text: Time since CNS-directed treatment is ≥28 days prior to randomization.

criteria.text: The participant has a history of leptomeningeal metastasis.

source.text: Participants with a history of leptomeningeal metastasis are excluded.

criteria.text: The participant had prior treatment with an anti-PD-L1 agent (where indicated per protocol) within 5 half-lives.

source.text: Prior treatment with an anti-PD-L1 agent (where indicated per protocol) within 5 half-lives.

criteria.text: The participant had previous receipt of an MMAE-containing agent or prior docetaxel.

source.text: Previous receipt of an MMAE-containing agent or prior docetaxel.
